title: Acceptance probability of the Boolean AND tester
statement: For a natural number $n$, let $f$ be a Boolean-valued function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube. The acceptance probability of the tester that samples independent uniform inputs $x,y$, queries $f(x)$, $f(y)$, and $f(x\wedge y)$, and accepts when $f(x)\wedge f(y)=f(x\wedge y)$, equals the probability of that equality; equivalently, it is the uniform expectation over $x$ and $y$ of its indicator.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean-valued function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube
